name: Archer Pull-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar using a wide overhand grip with straight arms and legs steady beneath you.
Brace your core and set your shoulder blades down before pulling.
Pull your chest up toward one hand while straightening the opposite arm out to the side along the bar.
Lower slowly back to a centered straight-arm hang, then pull toward the other hand, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your legs quiet to avoid swinging or kipping into the pull.
Guide the assisting arm smoothly straight rather than letting that shoulder collapse.
